name: btop
author: blabbleu
description: A btop-style system monitor as its own WebUI page (rail icon). CPU graph with per-core meters and temps, memory/swap, disks with I/O, network up/down graphs, a Hermes box that groups agent/WebUI/cron/MCP/swe-pilot processes, and a sortable, filterable process table with tree view, details and signals. Data comes from a stdlib-only loopback sidecar reading /proc.

post_install.summary: Start the bundled sidecar (sidecar/hermes-btop-sidecar.service as a systemd user unit, or python3 -S sidecar.py) on 127.0.0.1:17797, then approve the proxy in Settings → Extensions → Diagnostics → Loopback sidecars. Requires WebUI auth on (token-v1).

filesystem.note: Sidecar reads /proc and /sys only; command lines are secret-masked before leaving it. Signals (TERM/INT/HUP/KILL/STOP/CONT) can be disabled with BTOP_SIGNALS=0.
